content.text:
The streamed conversation can emit the following event types:

- `conversation.response.started`
- `tool.execution.started`
- `tool.execution.done`
- `message.output.delta`
- `conversation.response.done`

[Streaming Output Example](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agents-api#streaming-output-example)
